item.title: Sprint 0 — foundation, research, spec freeze
item.description: Development, not a release. The monorepo, seven architecture decisions, two de-risking spikes, a hello-world on every one of the six surfaces, the frozen spec, and a placeholder page live on the domain. No public build has shipped and there is nothing to download. Known issues are listed on the changelog page.
